

The issue: uppercase majors like `C`, `G` need sharps while lowercase `c`, `d` minors need flats. Fixing the key check to use exact case:

<tool_call>
<function=edit>
<parameter=new>
	switch tonic {
	case "F", "f", "c", "d", "g": // F major and c/d/f/g minor use flats
		chromatic = chromaticFlat
</parameter>
<parameter=old>
	switch strings.ToLower(tonic) {
	case "c", "d", "f", "g": // natural-tonic minor keys use flats
		chromatic = chromaticFlat
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
